build.template: Run `opam exec -- dune build` and fix any compilation errors.

test.template: Run `opam exec -- dune runtest` and fix any test failures.

fmt.template: Run `opam exec -- dune fmt` to format all code. If it reports changes, stage them.

copyright.template: Run `./scripts/check-copyright.sh --fix` to fix copyright headers, then verify with `./scripts/check-copyright.sh`.

pre-commit.template:
Run the full pre-commit sequence:
1. `opam exec -- dune fmt`
2. `./scripts/check-copyright.sh --fix`
3. `opam exec -- dune build`
4. `opam exec -- dune runtest`
Fix any issues found at each step before proceeding to the next.
pre-commit.description: Full pre-commit check (fmt + copyright + build + test)

index.template: Run `opam exec -- dune build @ocaml-index` to rebuild the OCaml LSP index for project-wide references.

archdb.template:
Query the architecture database at docs/architecture.db. Use `sqlite3 docs/architecture.db` to run the query. If the database doesn't exist, create it with `sqlite3 docs/architecture.db < docs/architecture-schema.sql` first.

Query: $ARGUMENTS
